Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Auto-fill virtual machine name

Body.Content:
Azure DevTest Labs is introducing features that will reduce the time required for a lab user to create a virtual machine. 

When you create a virtual machine as a lab user, the name of the machine is now pre-filled with a unique, automatically generated name. To get a preview and learn more about how this feature works, see the blog post.
